parsed.rationale: I don't agree that this ECG is normal: it shows sinus rhythm with QS complexes in V1–V4, about 2–3 mm of convex ST elevation in V2–V3 and deep T-wave inversion across V1–V5, which fits an anterior MI (possibly evolving or subacute) that meets STEMI voltage criteria and needs urgent clinical correlation.
